tasks.label: Expo: Start Android
tasks.command: $adb = Join-Path $env:ANDROID_HOME 'platform-tools\adb.exe'; $devices = & $adb devices; if ($devices -notmatch 'emulator-\d+\s+device') { Start-Process (Join-Path $env:ANDROID_HOME 'emulator\emulator.exe') -ArgumentList '-avd','Medium_Phone'; & $adb wait-for-device }; npx expo start --android --localhost

background.endsPattern: Metro: exp://.*:8081|Android Bundled|Waiting on .*:8081|Logs for your project will appear below
